title: Good quality, it needs better hardware for assembly.
text:
Good quality, it needs better hardware for assembly.. It's nice in appearance and made of real wood which is a plus. It rolls nicely. The wheels are big and very obvious, which is fine if you don't mind because they do support the cart.

It took approximately 3 hours to put together.

The construction is nice, the reason for the 3 starts is due to the hardware included to put it together.

The camlocks didn't work correctly. Higher quality camlocks would have helped solve the problem. Also glue should be recommended to glue the pegs in for extra support.

product_metadata.title: Home Styles Furniture Danville Kitchen Cart, White Finish
description: Do you need more storage in your kitchen? home styles has a solution, the Danville kitchen cart! the Danville is perfect for any kitchen requiring additional storage. The adorable Danville kitchen cart is versatile and cute, portraying a small town atmosphere with mission styling, and constructed of durable materials like hardwood solids and veneers. Perfectly completed with a white finish, making this cart a perfect fit for all of your kitchen storage needs! this cart is equipped with one storage drawer, one fixed shelf, one door that leads to storage, four casters (two locking), wine/bottle storage that accommodates 12 bottles, towel holder, brushed nickel hardware, and leaf that extends the width to 47.5 Inches. Finished on all sides. Finish and measurements may vary slightly. Assembly required. Size: 35.5w 22D 35.5h.
